title: Settings
desc: Each person's own settings: the name the team sees, the email address, and which reminders the app sends. Changes are kept only after Save.

scenarios.title: As after signing up
scenarios.desc: Name and email filled in, all three reminders on: a new task given to you, a summary every morning, and a reminder the day before a task is due.

scenarios.title: Every reminder off
scenarios.desc: Someone turned off all three reminders: a yellow note under them warns that late tasks will now only show on the list. Saving is still allowed.
